title: Flow run request
description: POST /api/v1/flows/run request body. The caller names a flow spec; it never builds tool commands itself.

flow.description: Path to an aemp.flow/v1 spec, resolved by the Platform (not by the caller).

inputs.description: Reserved (M6.1): per-invocation input overrides. M6.0 rejects non-empty overrides with INVALID_REQUEST.
